# Punch-in Jump Cut

**Cut › Jump Cut** · v1.0.0 · 24 frames at 30 fps (8–60)

Cuts to the next shot framed tighter, then cuts again to the normal framing: the vlog punch-in for emphasis.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/jump-cut-punch@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Vlogs and talking heads
- Emphasising a line
- Tightening a long take

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import jumpCutPunch from './transitions/01-cut/jump-cut/jump-cut-punch';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(jumpCutPunch, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 24 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scale` | number | `1.18` | 1.02–1.6 | How far the punch-in zooms. |
| `originX` | number | `0.5` | 0–1 | Zoom centre, x (0..1). |
| `originY` | number | `0.4` | 0–1 | Zoom centre, y (0..1). |
